# Data Preprocessing

### 1. Read data
```{r}
df_raw <- read_csv(
  "Police_Department_Incident_Reports__2018-2019_to_Present_20261123.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

```

### 2. Check raw resolution values
```{r}
cat("=== Raw Resolution values ===\n")
print(table(df_raw$Resolution, useNA = "always"))
```

### 3. Clean and preprocess
```{r}
df_clean <- df_raw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(incident_year %in% c(2018, 2019)) %>%
  filter(police_district != "Out of SF") %>%
  mutate(
    year = factor(incident_year),
    month = factor(
      format(as.Date(incident_date, format = "%Y/%m/%d"), "%m")
    ),
    district = factor(as.character(police_district)),
    category = factor(incident_category),
    
    resolved_binary = case_when(
      resolution %in% c("Cite or Arrest Adult", "Exceptional Adult") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    
    category_grouped = fct_lump(
      category,
      n = 10,
      other_level = "OTHER"
    )
  )

```

### 4. Check outcome distribution
```{r}
cat("\n=== Resolution status distribution ===\n")
table(df_clean$resolved_binary)
```

### 5. Check missing categories
```{r}
cat("\n=== Missing crime categories ===\n")
sum(is.na(df_clean$category_grouped))
```

### 6. Check sample size
```{r}
cat("\n=== Cleaned sample size ===\n")
nrow(df_clean)
```


# Q1
### Exclude missing crime category
```{r}
df_model <- df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(category_grouped))

```

### Aggregate incident counts
```{r}
df_counts <- df_model %>%
  count(
    district,
    year,
    month,
    category_grouped,
    name = "crime_count"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    district,
    year,
    month,
    category_grouped,
    fill = list(crime_count = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    district = relevel(district, ref = "Bayview")
  )


```

### Check total number of combinations & Fit model
```{r}
nrow(df_counts)
# Fit Negative Binomial model
model_nb <- glm.nb(
  crime_count ~ district + year + month + category_grouped,
  data = df_counts
)

summary(model_nb)

```

### Extract IRR and confidence intervals
```{r}
res_nb_new <- tidy(
  model_nb,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "^district")) %>%
  mutate(
    district = str_remove(term, "^district"),
    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    district,
    IRR = estimate,
    CI_low = conf.low,
    CI_high = conf.high,
    p.value,
    sig
  ) %>%
  arrange(IRR)

print(res_nb_new, n = Inf)

```

### Forest plot
```{r}

plot_nb <- ggplot(
  res_nb_new,
  aes(x = IRR, y = reorder(district, IRR))
) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = CI_low,
      xmax = CI_high,
      color = sig
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 1,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Adjusted Incident Count Ratios by Police District",
    x = "Incident Count Ratio (Log Scale)",
    y = "Police District",
    color = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot_nb)

ggsave(
  "plot_district_irr_updated.png",
  plot_nb,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
levels(df_counts$district)
```

# Q2: Logistic Regression 
### Fit logistic regression model
```{r}
model_logit <- glm(
  resolved_binary ~ category_grouped + district + year,
  data = df_model,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

```

### Check model results
```{r}

summary(model_logit)

```

### Extract odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals
```{r}
res_logit <- tidy(
  model_logit,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "^category_grouped")) %>%
  mutate(
    term = str_remove(term, "^category_grouped"),
    sig = ifelse(
      p.value < 0.05,
      "Significant",
      "Not Significant"
    )
  )

```

### Print results
```{r}
print(res_logit, n = Inf)
```

### Q2 Logistic Regression Forest Plot
```{r}
plot_logit <- ggplot(
  res_logit,
  aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(term, estimate))
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = sig),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = conf.low,
      xmax = conf.high,
      color = sig
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 1,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Odds Ratios of Resolution by Crime Category",
    x = "Odds Ratio (Log Scale)",
    y = "Crime Category",
    color = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

### Display plot
```{r}
print(plot_logit)

```

### Save plot
```{r}
ggsave(
  "plot_category_or.png",
  plot_logit,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

```
